judgement.summary: This is a detailed migration consulting portfolio organised around preparation and rollback, supported by explanatory diagrams and carefully attributed evidence. Its greatest weakness is that the working documents organise only one chapter, leaving the overall page as conventional portfolio sections without a continuous central object.
